subject.title: Google Chat: Add user OAuth support for reactions and media uploads

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add a user OAuth credential model for user-scope operations, and what SecretRef/config shape should become the permanent contract?
rationale: This changes credential storage, user consent/scopes, fallback behavior, and Google Chat auth routing; automation can prove the gap but cannot choose the product and security boundary.

options.title: Approve plugin-local user OAuth
options.body: Implement SecretRef-backed user OAuth credentials and route reactions, attachment upload, reaction typing, and proactive DM lookup through scoped user OAuth clients.

options.title: Limit to service-account fallbacks
options.body: Keep Google Chat service-account-only and address media/message-loss with warnings or text-link fallbacks, leaving native uploads, reactions, and proactive email-alias DMs unsupported.

options.title: Defer to broader Workspace auth design
options.body: Hold this feature until Google Workspace integrations share a common consent, credential, and admin-approval pattern, accepting the current Google Chat capability gaps for now.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-local user OAuth
recommendation.body: Implement SecretRef-backed user OAuth credentials and route reactions, attachment upload, reaction typing, and proactive DM lookup through scoped user OAuth clients.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent combination of Google Chat code history and prior maintainer-side review context for this exact OAuth request.
